description: Sample N tileable albedo textures at the plane's UV * uv_tile, weight-blend the results using biome_blend's weights, return ALBEDO. Per-biome animation: any biome with `animate: true` in its dict uses a TIME-driven UV warp (two crossed sin/cos scrolls) instead of the static UV — typically used for water.
_pairing_note: Must follow biome_blend in the same fragment stage; reads its w_<name> locals implicitly. The compiler doesn't track per-biome weight vars individually because they're emitted as a side-effect list, not a single named value.

biomes.doc: biome list with name + albedo + animate flag

uv_tile.doc: how many times to tile across the plane

world_pos.doc: world position varying (for animation phase offset)

scroll_amplitude.doc: UV warp magnitude for animated biomes
